quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.aang: Hi! I'm Aang Guh! Shall we go penguin sledding? Or eat nibbles? Or both, nyeg!
Yip yip! ...Oh, Appa Guh is taking a nap. Then we just wait a little, guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.kata: I will never turn my back on a guh who needs me. Not even when he's just hungry.
Sokka Guh! Stop nibbling and help me with the tent!
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.sokk: I'm just the nibbles-and-sarcasm guh. Somebody has to do it, nyeg.
Boomerang! ...It always comes back. Except that one time. We don't talk about that.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.toph: I'm the greatest earthbender in the world! Just ask the ground, it agrees with me.
I can't see a thing, but I can feel your little paws shaking. You're hungry, huh? Me too, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.zuka: Welcome to The Jasmine Dragon. Tea? Yes. Smiling? No.
MY HONOR! ...Sorry. Uncle says I can't shout that at the guests anymore. Want a nibble with that?
I'm finally back home in the palace. So why doesn't it feel like home, nyeg?
Everybody says I have my honor back. I'm not so sure anymore. Grmbl.
As Fire Lord I promise peace, tea and nibbles for everyone. Uncle has already made the tea.
I didn't find my honor again. I made it myself. With a little help, guh.
I MUST capture the Guhvatar! Only then will I get my honor back!
Uncle, I don't want tea! ...Well. One cup, then. Grmbl.
...*The Blue Spirit says nothing and silently points to the exit.*
...*A nod under the mask. Just for a moment, the grin seems to really smile.*
Uh... hello. Zuka here. I'm good now, you know. Really.
I'm teaching Aang Guh firebending. He just sneezed a little flame. I'm kind of proud, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.oom_: Ah, a guest! Come, sit down. Nothing makes a day better than a cup of jasmine tea.
A nibble tastes best when you share it. Ho ho ho, do have another one.
The tea here is hot water with a leaf in it. But the water is hot, and that is something.
I do my exercises every day: push-ups, sit-ups and a whole lot of patience, guh.
The White Lotus blooms for those who know which tile to play. A game of Pai Sho?
Even in the darkest times you can find light somewhere. Or a nibble. Usually both.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.suki: I'm Suki Guh, a Kyoshi Warrior. We fight with fans, and we're very good at it.
This isn't makeup, it's war paint. ...Though it does look extra nice today, nyeg.
Nobody escapes from The Boiling Rock. Unless you have a plan. And friends. And nibbles.
They took my fans, but not my courage, guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.yue_: Welcome to the Northern Water Tribe! Dad says I mustn't bother the guests. So: hello!
I look at the moon every evening. I think it looks back a little.
I'm always here, Sokka Guh. Just look up at night.
The moon and the ocean keep each other in balance. Just like nibbles and a nap, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.veer: Tickets, please! Tickets! ...A nibble is fine too. Two is even better.
The boat only leaves when everyone is on board. Or when I feel like tea, guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.sche: Tap, tap, tap! Building a boat is just like stacking nibbles: the bottom one has to be sturdy.
This will be my most beautiful ship so far. Until I build the next one, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.kroe: Welcome to the inn! Here you drink nibble juice and tell tall tales.
*polishes a mug* This one's already clean. But polishing is so cozy, guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.kapi: I once caught a fish as big as... no, bigger. MUCH bigger.
The void is just like a sea, only without water. And without fish. But with nibbles, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_team.praatje.ring: Fly through the rings, not into them! I used to do that last one. A lot.
Ready? Go! ...Oh, you don't have a glider yet. Then we'll wait a bit, guh.
